The subdivision north of Parnell Avenue is primarily single family residential with some two, four, and eight family units located along 13th Street. Between 13th Street and the railroad the land use is presently in use as a dump site, truck storage yard and railroad siding area. The area is zoned for light industrial use.
Adjacent, but west of the railroad tracks, is the 'lisconsin Electric Power Company's high voltage transmission tower lines. These lines would have to be adjusted since the freeway facility would be elevated at 13th Street, the railroad tracks, and 6th Street.
East of the railroad tracks the location of the corridor was revised and shifted to the north to be compatible with the new airport limits of the proposed air cargo area. In recent months Milwaukee County has implemented their Master Plan for airport terminal expansion and has acquired the lands necessary for the development of this 60 acre air cargo area. Grange Avenue from 6th Street to Howell Avenue will also be vacated for the new air cargo area and would be relocated north of the proposed freeway facility. These lands, already acquired by Milwaukee County, included the entire subdivision to the south.
